form.subtitle: Builds the Cargo project and runs it as the home's Linux user. Publish it from Rules → Port Share.
form.name: App name
form.workdirHelp: The folder with Cargo.toml. Leave blank to use the home directory.
form.portNote: Port {port}. A running app restarts with the new settings.
form.argsHelp: Each start runs {build} and starts the Cargo binary with these plain arguments, without a shell. To run another file, start with its path, e.g. {example}. The app reads its port from the {env} environment variable and must listen on 127.0.0.1.
